87 white students enrolled at Flat Rock Academic Virtual Academy (6-12) in 2024-25
Flat Rock Academic Virtual Academy (6-12) had 87 white students enrolled in the 2024-25 school year, a decline of 12.1% from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
The school enrolled 107 students in the 2024-25 school year, with white students making up 81.3% of the student body, the largest ethnic group at the school.
The school is part of Flat Rock Community Schools District, whose central office is in Flat Rock.
Among the district's five schools, Flat Rock Community High School had the highest number of white students in the 2024-25 school year.
